cards.card_text: At the place the LORD will choose, Moses says to go to the Levitical ___ and to the judge who presides at that time.
cards.verse_text: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time.
cards.snippet: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time.

cards.card_text: Once he's seated on his royal throne, the king must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll, with the Levitical priests right there.
cards.verse_text: When he is seated on his royal throne, he must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.
cards.snippet: …copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.

cards.card_text: Moses, Israel's leader, is still preaching to the whole nation, and now he talks about the Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi.
cards.verse_text: The Levitical priests—indeed the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel.

cards.verse_text: In cases of infectious skin diseases, be careful to diligently follow everything the Levitical priests instruct you.

cards.card_text: Now Moses and the Levitical priests speak to all Israel.

cards.card_text: Then the officers go through the camp with orders: watch for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, carried by the Levitical priests.
cards.verse_text: After three days the officers went through the camp and commanded the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.
cards.snippet: …of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.

cards.card_text: All Israel, with their elders, officers and judges, stands on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, facing the Levitical priests who carry it.
cards.verse_text: All Israel, foreigners and citizens alike, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD facing the Levitical priests who carried it.
cards.snippet: …sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD facing the Levitical priests who carried it.

cards.card_text: The Levitical priests carry the ark up, and with it comes the Tent of Meeting and all its sacred furnishings.
cards.verse_text: The Levitical priests carried them up.
cards.snippet: The Levitical priests carried them up.

cards.card_text: The Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives, stand on the east side of the altar in fine linen with cymbals, harps and lyres, and 120 priests with trumpets join them.

cards.card_text: Then the Lord GOD gives the statutes for the altar's first days, served by the Levitical priests from the family of Zadok, a priest in King David's day (2 Samuel 8:17): seven days of sin offerings and burnt offerings, blood on the altar's horns and salt on the burnt offerings, until the altar is cleansed and consecrated.
cards.verse_text: Then He said to me: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed, so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be splattered on it: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok, who approach Me to minister before Me, declares the Lord GOD.

cards.card_text: Then God speaks about the Levitical priests descended from Zadok.
cards.verse_text: But the Levitical priests, who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, are to approach Me to minister before Me.

cards.card_text: If perfection could come through the Levitical priesthood, why was another priest still needed, one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron, the priest God set apart (Exodus 28:1)?
cards.verse_text: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
